title: libpod: fix exec --user not resolving supplementary groups
body:
This PR fixes an issue where `podman exec --user` fails to resolve supplementary groups for container users. `getUserOverrides()` checked `c.state.BindMounts["/etc/passwd"]` to locate dynamically generated user entries but missed the corresponding check for `c.state.BindMounts["/etc/group"]`. As a result, exec sessions fell back to reading `/etc/group` from the static image rootfs instead of the bind-mounted version generated at container start. Adding the missing `/etc/group` lookup ensures supplementary groups are properly initialized, and an e2e test has been added to cover this scenario.

- Fixes: #29170
